title: Prime Minister expresses gratitude for affection and blessings
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has expressed his gratitude for the affection and blessings received from people across the country, on the occasion of his birthday today. Shri Modi said that some gestures remain very special and deeply touch the heart. He described 'Ashirwad Ka Diya' as one such expression of affection that has deeply touched him. The Prime Minister said that every blessing strengthens his resolve to serve the people of  Bharat with even greater devotion.
Shri Modi posted on X:
Some gestures remain very special!
#AshirwadKaDiya is one such expression of affection that has deeply touched me.
Every blessing strengthens my resolve to serve our beloved Bharat with even greater devotion.
